tools.name: list_apps
tools.description: List all discoverable apps and their current status.

tools.name: stop_app
tools.description: Stop a running app by id.

tools.name: register_app
tools.description: Register a project directory or worktree checkout that has no .hub.json as a startable app (machine-local, written to registrations.json). `id` is the app id: a project's directory basename, or `<project>:<key>` for a worktree. `:` is reserved for that qualifier, so an id containing one is only ever resolved as a worktree — a project directory whose name contains `:` cannot be registered (or served) at all. Rejected if the directory already has a .hub.json. An optional fixed `port` (1024-65535) pins the app to that port on its default checkout instead of an allocated free one; worktrees ignore it and always get a free port. Multi-route apps (a routes array) can't be expressed in this schema — register those by hand-editing registrations.json directly.

tools.name: unregister_app
tools.description: Remove a machine-local registration for a project or worktree (from registrations.json), by app id. Has no effect on one with its own .hub.json.
